name: Daizen Ryouko
source:
A sexy woman who has just entered her 30's.

She's married, sexually experienced, and has yet to have children. She is a frequent visitor of the inn, and is visiting this time with her Kodama, her kouhai at work.

While her husband seems to be a kind man, the marriage has gone cold. She always has a smile on her beautiful face and conducts herself as the leader when with Kodama.

She has a fuller body than the proprietress, and has a very strong sexual appetite, inviting both men and women without discrimination.

She is a whore who has no desire to abide by any moral standards. She becomes very obedient to those she likes. Her masochistic temperament makes her take delight in the pain inflicted on her.
